articles.title: Bitdeer increased Bitcoin mining output by nearly fivefold in Q2
articles.snippet: Bitdeer mined 2,694 BTC in Q2, but ended the quarter holding just 150 BTC after liquidating its treasury earlier this year.

articles.title: Another Dormant Bitcoin Wallet Holding Millions Wakes Up After 12 Years
articles.snippet: A Bitcoin address that sat untouched for more than 12 years just moved 26.96 BTC, worth about $1.75 million.

articles.title: XRP Price Weakens as Crypto Market Awaits Clarity
articles.snippet: XRP is trading just above $1.00, still pinned under a death cross, as the legislative tailwind that lifted it in July loses steam.

articles.title: Bitcoin 'Anti-Spam' Fork Sputters to a Halt After Mining Just Two Blocks
articles.snippet: The breakaway chain drew just 2.53% of mining support, leaving its blocks hours apart and roughly 350 days from a difficulty adjustment while the main network powered ahead.
